给豆子一点水、一点空气和合适的温度，再翻开成长相册。: Give a bean water, air and a suitable temperature, then turn through its growth album.
太干了，豆子还没有吸到足够的水。试试湿润的环境。: Too dry: the bean has not taken up enough water. Try a damp setting.
豆子需要氧气。水太多会挤走土里的空气，正常成长会受阻。: A bean needs oxygen. Too much water displaces air in soil and prevents normal growth.
太冷了，豆子的成长会变慢。这里用暂停来表示，试试温暖。: Cold slows growth. We show this as a pause. Try warmth.
先猜猜：会先长根，还是先长叶？: Guess first: will a root or a leaf appear first?
种皮裂开，小根先钻出来，开始吸收水。: The seed coat splits. A tiny root emerges first and starts taking up water.
小根向下，嫩芽向上。豆子储存的养分帮助它起步。: The root grows down and the shoot grows up. Stored nutrients help the bean get started.
真叶展开了！长大的小苗还需要光，才能自己制造养分。: True leaves unfold! The growing seedling also needs light to make its own food.
种子吸水后恢复代谢；呼吸需要氧气，温度影响反应速度。以菜豆为例，胚根先突破种皮，: Water uptake restarts metabolism; respiration needs oxygen, and temperature affects reaction rates. In common beans the radicle emerges first, the hypocotyl lifts the cotyledons, and true leaves unfold. Stored reserves support early growth; established seedlings need photosynthesis.
相册不是按真实天数计时。这里只演示健康菜豆的典型过程；太冷用暂停表示，不代表所有: This album does not show elapsed days. It represents a typical healthy common bean. Cold is shown as a pause, though growth need not stop completely. Flooding represents limited oxygen supply. Species, dormancy, disease and light requirements vary.
水不是越多越好: More water is not always better
湿润的土里既有水，也有空气。豆子发芽需要水和氧气。: Damp soil contains both water and air. A germinating bean needs water and oxygen.
请大人陪你把豆子放在湿润的纸巾上，每天观察、画一张图。别把豆子一直泡在水里。: With a grown-up, place a bean on a damp paper towel. Observe and draw it each day. Do not keep it submerged.
